content: Arduino-ESP32 3.3.11 is current and based on ESP-IDF 5.5.5. pioarduino platform-espressif32 55.03.311 pins that pair; official PlatformIO espressif32 7.0.1 remains on Arduino 2.0.17 and is incompatible with the board library 3.x requirement. LovyanGFX 1.2.26 and ArduinoJson 7.4.3 are current; ButtonSense manifest says 1.0.0 while its Git tag is 0.1.0.
